data.trait: Time Of Day Of Highest Acoustic Activity

notes.0: SELECT `source` as `source`, `traitID` as `id`, `Taxonomic.name` as `taxon`, `Trait` as `trait`, `Ontology.Link` as `trait_ontology`, `Value` as `value`, `Call.Type` as `call_type`, `Call.Type.Link` as `call_type_ontology`, `Call.Part` as `call_part`, `Call.Qualifier` as `call_qualifier`, `Sex` as `sex`, `Temperature` as `temperature`, `min` as `value_min`, `max` as `value_max` FROM `audioblast`.`traits` WHERE `source` = 'bio.acousti.ca' AND `traitID` = '33170'  LIMIT 0, 50;
